Gate Releases Latest Proof of Reserves: Total Reserves Reach $8.688B Crypto exchange Gate released its latest Proof of Reserves report showing total reserves grew 5.7% period-over-period to $8.688 billion as of October 18, 2026, with an overall reserve ratio of 118.49% across 500 supported digital assets. Across core holdings, BTC platform reserves reached 25,727 BTC (121.60% reserve ratio) and ETH reserves climbed to 449,042 ETH (123.78% reserve ratio). Total stablecoin holdings (USDT, USD1, GUSD, USDC) stood backed by $1.746 billion in platform reserves, marking a 116.59% ratio, while DOGE, GT, and SOL maintained reserve ratios of 106.76%, 129.00%, and 102.51%, respectively. — link

ZachXBT: Institution Suspected of Losing $2.84M to North Korean Group SquidSquad On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that an unnamed institution was suspected of being compromised on BNB Chain on October 8, losing roughly $2.84 million to North Korea-linked entity SquidSquad. According to his tracking, the attacker deposited 1,111.2 ETH into Tornado Cash on October 20, withdrew the funds across three addresses, and bridged the proceeds from Ethereum to Tron via USDT0. The funds were then aggregated into two addresses that show transaction linkages to wallets previously attributed to North Korea. Within minutes, the stolen assets were routed through intermediary addresses to Chinese OTC brokers, a tactic ZachXBT believes was intended to evade potential asset freezes by Tether. — link

US Spot Bitcoin ETFs Log $23.16M in Net Inflows on Oct 20 According to SoSoValue, US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a total net inflow of $23.1624 million on October 20 (EDT), led by BlackRock with an inflow of $29.8650 million. Meanwhile, spot Ethereum ETFs saw a total net outflow of $26.1343 million yesterday, marking five consecutive days of net outflows. — link

Zcash Plans NU7 Activation Around November 5, Cutting Block Times to 25 Seconds Zcash developers have agreed on block 3,543,405 for NU7 activation, expected around November 5. The upgrade will reduce block times from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. It will also temporarily remove 60% of each block’s transaction fees from circulation, with payments to miners beginning around February 2031, while preserving the existing mining reward halving schedule. Zcash’s original privacy system, Sprout, will shut down entirely, making any funds not moved before activation unspendable. As of October 21 at 08:00 (UTC), the activation-height proposal had not yet been merged into the deployment specification. The chosen height must also be incorporated into node software before the upgrade can take effect. — link
